text:
They killed you and did not

tell us where

they buried your body,

but since then

the whole territory

is your sepulcher

or rather:

in every span

of national territory

where

your body is not

you resurrected

they believed they were

killing you with an order

of Fire!

they believed they were

burying you

and what they were doing

was burying a seed.

translation.title: Epitaph for the Tomb of Adolfo Báez Bone
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the epitaph's transformation of a hidden body into national resurrection.
